- **Photos left on the drive are put back by themselves (FL-1532):** when the file check finds a photo or video in Frameleaf's folders that no library lists, it now reads the file once and sorts it. A photo your library listed as missing is joined to its file again, with its albums, people and edits. A photo no library has is added to the library of the account whose folder it is in. A second copy of a photo you already have is left where it is. Nothing is moved, renamed or deleted, and a file that has not changed is never read twice. Files in a folder no account uses, files that can't be read, and photos an account has no room for still wait in the list. The page for reviewing and undoing these comes in a later version.
- **Edit a photo's title, artist and copyright (FL-932):** set them on one photo or many at once, search by them, and have them written to the photo's XMP file. A Clients shoot can fill them in for you.
- **See all of a photo's metadata (FL-935):** the viewer has an All metadata panel that shows everything recorded in the photo and its XMP file, with search and copy. Camera, lens and keywords link to a Library search.
- **Attach or replace a photo's XMP file (FL-939):** upload XMP files with your photos and they are matched by name, or attach or replace one from the viewer.
- **My style (FL-996):** Frameleaf can learn how you edit from at least 50 of your own edits and apply that look to a shoot or a selection. The style stays on your server and can be forgotten at any time.
- **Client galleries in bulk (FL-1055):** in Clients, paste a list of people, choose the folders, check each invitation and create all the private galleries in one go.
- **Find yourself in a client gallery (FL-1058):** the server can now search one gallery with a guest's selfie. The selfie is used for that search only and is not kept.
- **Frameleaf Assistant can look, not touch (FL-1511):** an assistant app you connect can be given read-only access to search photos and browse albums. You approve it in your Library and can take it away at once.
- **Merging people no longer fails on a busy library (FL-1530):** merges that queued behind other people changes used to stop with an error.
- **Imports accept the same photo in two folders (FL-1505):** importing from Nextcloud, Piwigo, PiGallery2, Photoview, Lychee and LibrePhotos merges the two instead of refusing the import.
- **Security fixes (FL-1499 to FL-1504, FL-1506):** seven fixes from a review of recent work, including a connected app that could share an owner's photos through a new album.
- **Manager on a computer without Docker (FL-1512):** it accepts a renewed certificate and changed ports, and tells a paired Frameleaf Desktop whether your photos are running.
- **Desktop AI on the graphics card (FL-1509):** the desktop AI runtime checks the model files it loads and can qualify to run on Intel graphics.
